en.title: TripNest — Travel Booking
en.subtitle: Flights, hotels, buses, cars
en.short_description: Compare flights, hotels, buses and cars in one search, then book with partners.
en.description:
TripNest is built around a trip, not a booking. Create "Mumbai to Goa, Oct 12-16" once, then add a flight, a bus, a stay and an airport transfer to that same itinerary — and see the whole thing in one place instead of across four tabs and three inboxes.

—— One search, six ways to travel ——

Flights · Hotels · Cars · Buses · Stays + Flight · Airport transfer. One search journey covers all of them, so you can find out that the bus plus a night's stay beats the flight before you book the flight.

—— What you can do ——

TRIPS
Each trip holds its legs together. Add, remove and reorder them as the plan changes.

SEARCH AND RESULTS
Compare options across partners side by side, with the real total rather than a teaser fare.

SAVED
Keep options you are still deciding between, and come back to them.

DEALS FROM YOUR ORIGIN
Home surfaces deals that leave from where you actually are, not generic offers.

—— No account, ever ——

TripNest has no sign-in. Your trips, saved options and preferences live on your device. The Menu deliberately offers no login rather than a button that leads nowhere.

—— How TripNest makes money ——

Booking completes on a partner's own site through a tracked affiliate link, which may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. It never changes the order of results. We are not the seller: the partner's price, terms, cancellation policy and support apply to your booking.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing TripNest.

TripNest is a travel metasearch app covering flights, hotels, cars, buses, stays and airport transfers. There is NO account and NO sign-in - the Menu deliberately offers no login. Bookings are not completed in-app: the app hands off to a partner's site through a tracked affiliate link, which is disclosed in the listing, in the terms and in-app.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app. Home opens on the four headline categories with deals from the detected origin - no sign-in step exists.
2. Open Search and pick any of the six categories, then run a search to see the results list.
3. Open a result to see its detail screen and the real total.
4. Tap Save, then open the Saved tab to confirm it persisted.
5. Open Trips and create a trip, then add more than one leg to it - this is the core idea of the app.
6. Open Menu to confirm there is no login option, by design.
7. Tapping through to book opens the partner's own site; TripNest does not take payment or hold booking data.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your trips, saved options and search preferences, held on your device. No account and no personal details.
• Network: Searches sent to travel partner and aggregator APIs to return availability and prices.
• Location: Used only to detect your origin for deals and nearby search, and only while you are using the app. You can decline and type an origin instead.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt. Outbound partner links carry an affiliate tag identifying TripNest as the referrer, not identifying you.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
